featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 补齐GPUI来源校验的分组补丁解析，并同步Linux知识库及当前工程计划。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Complete grouped GPUI patch verification and update Linux engineering knowledge and the current development plan.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复静态图片首次解码后空白，首帧无需鼠标操作、图库刷新或动画驱动。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix blank static images after initial decoding without requiring pointer input, gallery refresh or animation timers.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复Linux关闭主窗口时重复借用窗口，确保存在真实托盘入口时可隐藏并恢复。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix a reentrant window borrow when closing the Linux main window, preserving hide and restore through a real tray entry.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复GNOME找不到包内图标，实际生成512像素PNG并安装到标准hicolor目录。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix missing GNOME package icons by generating a real 512-pixel PNG in the standard hicolor directory.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加Linux GNU x64/ARM64原生及交叉构建，支持deb与tar.gz打包并校验最终资源。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add native and cross-architecture Linux GNU x64/ARM64 builds with deb and tar.gz packaging and final resource verification.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠先读取设置后Hooks启用配置未发布的问题，覆盖五种Agent的真实命令链路。
bugFixes.en-US: Publish enabled Agent settings after pet-first loads so Hooks work through the real command paths of all five Agents.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复X11/XWayland桌宠设置保存、悬浮置顶、尺寸锁定和鼠标穿透，异步确认后落盘并保留退出前意图。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix X11/XWayland pet preference persistence, topmost state, size locking and mouse passthrough; confirm native changes asynchronously and preserve shutdown intent.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Linux窗口Logo和一致的桌面身份，修复Dock及任务栏图标缺失。
bugFixes.en-US: Provide the Linux window Logo and consistent desktop identity to restore Dock and taskbar icons.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 确认真实托盘恢复入口后才隐藏主窗，入口消失时恢复窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Hide the main window only after confirming a real tray recovery entry, and restore it if that entry disappears.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Linux系统通知，修复权限重试、关闭重开及退出时的迟到投递。
bugFixes.en-US: Implement Linux system notifications and fix late delivery after permission retry, disable/re-enable and shutdown.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复受限umask导致的Linux包权限错误，避免提权安装误操作root Rust工具链。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Linux package permissions under restrictive umask and prevent elevated setup from modifying the root Rust toolchain.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 同步本地Harness的Linux打包能力及知识库，精确校验封存生成物和工程回归。
bugFixes.en-US: Synchronize local Harness Linux packaging capabilities and knowledge, with exact archived-generation verification and engineering regressions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 托盘新增开机自启选项，勾选状态与系统设置同步。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a launch-at-login option to the tray menu, reflecting the actual system setting.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 当天Token总量首次严格超过1B时通知一次，显示当前总量；跨日重新计数。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Notify once when daily tokens first exceed 1B, showing the current total and resetting for each new day.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增Hooks询问、错误与完成通知，并在Codex或WorkBuddy换肤实际成功、失败时提示结果。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add Hook decision, error and completion notifications, plus result notifications for successful or failed Codex and WorkBuddy skin changes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复取消、中断或关闭会话被误报为完成，以及普通工具执行被误报为需要决策。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent cancellations, interruptions and session closure from appearing as completion, and ordinary tool execution from appearing to require a decision.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复子Agent或无关并行工具解除主Agent询问；按工具调用与MCP澄清归属处理等待和回执。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep child agents and unrelated parallel tools from clearing the main agent decision state, correlating tool and MCP clarification requests with replies.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Claude提问、OpenCode独立工具回调及决策回执，修正Grok、Gemini、Copilot、Qwen和Kimi事件映射。
bugFixes.en-US: Cover Claude questions, OpenCode native tool callbacks and decision replies, and correct Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen and Kimi event mappings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: WorkBuddy和Hermes依据真实最终结果判断完成或失败；可恢复工具错误不再封死当前工作。
bugFixes.en-US: Use authoritative WorkBuddy and Hermes final outcomes for success or failure, and keep recoverable tool errors from retiring active work.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Codex和Grok的Stop允许同轮次继续；上游缺少确定成功信号时保守停发该事件的已完成通知。
bugFixes.en-US: Allow Codex and Grok to continue the same turn after Stop, and suppress its completion notification while upstream lacks a definitive success signal.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 通知状态独立于桌宠共享槽位，换肤结果由后台任务观察，离开页面不丢失已提交操作的结果。
bugFixes.en-US: Track notification state independently of shared pet slots and observe skin results in the background so leaving the page preserves submitted outcomes.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级 GPUI 组件与渲染基线至 gpui-kit 0.7.3、gpui-pre 0.3.9，保留项目的字体、圆角和原生窗口补丁。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Upgrade the GPUI component and rendering baseline to gpui-kit 0.7.3 and gpui-pre 0.3.9 while retaining project font, rounded-clip and native-window patches.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级 SeaORM 与数据库迁移依赖至 2.0.4，适配原始 SQL 接口并保持现有数据库结构和迁移记录。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Upgrade SeaORM and migration dependencies to 2.0.4, adapting raw SQL calls while preserving the existing database schema and migration ledger.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 更新 Windows、磁盘识别、ZIP、Base64 及其他 Rust 依赖，完成对应接口兼容适配。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Update Windows, disk detection, ZIP, Base64 and other Rust dependencies with the corresponding API compatibility adaptations.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 移除不属于项目负责人的 QQ 联系信息；窗口标题只保留应用名称和版本，界面模板不再生成该联系入口。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove the QQ contact that does not belong to the project owner. Window titles now contain only the app name and version, and retained UI templates no longer generate that contact entry.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 优化调用明细表分页渲染，追加记录时复用已有列宽测量。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Improve call-table pagination by reusing column measurements for previously loaded rows.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统计和图表在索引、覆盖状态及时间范围未变化时复用结果，减少自动刷新时的重复读取与聚合。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Reuse statistics and chart results while index, coverage and time scope remain unchanged, reducing repeated reads and aggregation during refresh.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复长期运行时换肤监视任务句柄持续累积的问题，及时释放已结束任务。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix accumulated skin watcher handles during long-running sessions by releasing completed tasks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: macOS 启动隐藏 Dock 图标，托盘恢复入口不可用时显示主窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Hide the Dock icon on macOS and show the main window if tray recovery is unavailable.

bugFixes.zh-CN: macOS 开机自启默认隐藏主窗口，重复自启不唤醒已有实例。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep the main window hidden at macOS login and avoid activating an existing instance during repeated login launches.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 macOS 通知权限错误判定，并为本地 App/DMG 补齐完整应用身份签名与核验。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct macOS notification permission error handling and bind and verify complete application identities in local App and DMG packages.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Windows 主窗口恢复、托盘显示、应用图标与当前用户自启路径处理。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct Windows main-window recovery, tray display, application icons and current-user login paths.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正桌宠尺寸上下限、拖动缩放回滚与设置窗口键盘遍历。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct pet resize limits, resize rollback and keyboard traversal in pet settings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Hooks 首次注册要求明确操作，完善 Windows/WSL 路径、流转发与运行位置保护。
bugFixes.en-US: Require explicit first-time Hook registration and improve Windows/WSL paths, stream forwarding and installation-location safeguards.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正增量索引的文件内容身份、缓存更新与重复来源发现后的通知档位保留。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct content identity and cache refresh in incremental indexing and preserve notification milestones across repeated source discovery.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正换肤图片解码、刷新时键盘焦点、语言切换反馈与 ZIP 导出覆盖处理。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct skin image decoding, keyboard focus during refresh, localized feedback and ZIP export overwrite handling.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Windows 安装卸载精确处理本安装拥有的进程、自启项与资源目录。
bugFixes.en-US: Make Windows installation and removal handle only the processes, login entries and resource directories owned by this installation.
